vine.command.help:
Available commands:
  - /server [server]            : View current server or switch to another backend
  - /send <player|all> <server> : Send players to another backend (Admin)
  - /list                       : List connected players
  - /glist                      : List players grouped by server
  - /help [command]             : Show this help or info about a command
  - /vine plugins|reload [name] : List or reload plugins (Admin)
vine.command.help.server:
Command /server:
  Usage: /server [server]
  Description: View your current server or switch to another backend server.
vine.command.help.send:
Command /send:
  Usage: /send <player|all> <server>
  Description: Send players to another backend server (Requires vine.command.send / admin).
vine.command.help.list:
Command /list:
  Usage: /list
  Description: List all online players connected to the proxy.
vine.command.help.glist:
Command /glist:
  Usage: /glist
  Description: List online players grouped by backend server.
vine.command.help.help:
Command /help:
  Usage: /help [command]
  Description: Show help information for available proxy commands.
vine.command.help.unknown: Unknown command. Use /help to see all available proxy commands.
